name: CHC Resources Corporation
summary: CHC Resources Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, produces, processes, and sells construction materials in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through Blast-Furnace Slag Cement Division, Resource Reutilization Division, and Others segments. The company offers blast furnace slag (BFS) powder; ground granulated and Portland blast furnace slag cement; iron powder; refractories; dry-mix mortar; soil improvement agents; lightweight partition grouting materials; and air-cooled BFS aggregates.
